nodes.label: All-branch integration workflow
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds the generated union branch deterministically and repairs semantic build collisions in bounded model rounds while keeping the model away from shell, Git, and source PRs.

nodes.label: Vercel prebuilt deployment workflow
nodes.rationale: Separates trusted deployment control and publishing from uncredentialed builds, and validates prebuilt output before publication.

nodes.label: Develop PR preview workflow
nodes.rationale: Uses protected controller phases for authorization and publishing while building exact PR snapshots without deployment secrets.

nodes.label: Native compile workflow
nodes.rationale: Runs trusted compilation logic with candidate source treated as opaque data, using a sanitized environment and isolated supervisor.

nodes.label: Dev server port coordination
nodes.rationale: Each project dev server uses a durable project-specific port selected after checking for conflicts.

nodes.label: GitHub project publishing
nodes.rationale: Existing repository changes are expected to be committed on a branch, pushed, and opened as a ready-for-review PR unless the user requests local-only work.

nodes.label: macOS app local installation
nodes.rationale: A verified runnable app is installed into the standard per-user Applications directory and the installed copy is checked.

nodes.label: macOS privacy permission signing and testing
nodes.norm_label: macos privacy permission signing and testing
nodes.rationale: Permission-sensitive testing requires a stable bundle identity and signing requirement; user-controlled privacy changes require contemporaneous confirmation.

nodes.label: MarkItDown
nodes.rationale: Supported file formats are converted to Markdown before the first read unless that format is explicitly disabled.

nodes.label: New workspace and worktree branches
nodes.rationale: New task worktrees branch from a freshly fetched canonical main and record the starting base SHA.

nodes.label: AI and automated PM2 safety
nodes.rationale: PM2 processes use deterministic task-aware identities, bounded restart policies, inspected ports, and post-change reachability verification.

nodes.label: Remote primary-branch safety
nodes.rationale: Remote primary-branch mutation is prohibited unless the exact action and repository are explicitly authorized.

nodes.label: Scheduled wake-ups
nodes.rationale: ScheduleWakeup is prohibited; recurring continuation uses cron-backed jobs with idempotency, overlap prevention, durable state, and explicit stop conditions.

nodes.label: Individually editable Thingtime blocks
nodes.rationale: Human-facing Things specify an explicit renderer, preserve editable Thing data, and expose interface elements as individually editable Builder blocks.

nodes.label: UI change verification
nodes.rationale: A user-visible feature requires live action/data-path acceptance and browser inspection at relevant desktop/mobile sizes, including full-page scrolling and meaningful dynamic states.

nodes.label: Vercel project setup
nodes.rationale: New web apps are connected to private GitHub repositories and Vercel, with the static shell and public paths verified in the deployed output.

nodes.label: Web app creation defaults
nodes.rationale: New web apps default to Nitro, React Router non-framework mode, and Vite; interfaces use a slide-out drawer and host-prefixed non-production titles.

nodes.label: Production storage runtime monitor workflow
nodes.rationale: Monitor verifies current production health and runtime logs using the protected storage release gate.

nodes.label: CodeQL Dispositions Job
nodes.rationale: Applies only validated evidence-backed dispositions through an isolated job with narrow security write permission.

nodes.label: Feature Stack Progress Job
nodes.rationale: Streams progress updates while keeping reporting optional and non-blocking.

nodes.label: Review Job
nodes.rationale: Runs one serialized repository review session, preserves immutable evidence, and assigns publishing and CodeQL writes to trusted follow-up steps.

nodes.label: Review Detect Job
nodes.rationale: Avoids re-reviewing unchanged clean PRs, defers scans when GitHub's shared API budget is exhausted, and fails closed when an event has no derivable review scope.

nodes.label: Saved Agent overview workspace
nodes.rationale: Task and agent lifecycle records use saved private Things and Actions after negotiating the required origin-scoped capability.

nodes.label: api.agent-overview capability
nodes.rationale: The capability must be negotiated at version 2.0.0 before reading the private saved workspace graph.

nodes.label: Signed JWT session cookie
nodes.rationale: The authentication cookie carries jti, sub, and exp; the Mongo sessions record supports revocation.

nodes.label: Thingtime API
nodes.rationale: All data access is routed through the Thingtime API and API utils; UI, scripts, and tests must not access MongoDB directly.

nodes.label: Repository-aware Graphify router
nodes.rationale: The router validates atomic graph output, serializes writers, and activates a valid replacement before pruning older snapshots.

nodes.label: Graphify
nodes.rationale: Queries use scoped graph results, while generated artifacts are published through immutable snapshots and content-addressed semantic cache variants.

nodes.label: Rebase PR Stacks Workflow
nodes.rationale: The workflow isolates the rebasing repository, retries conflict resolution sequentially, refreshes Graphify outputs, validates live refs and local state, publishes with an exact force-with-lease, and coordinates stacked child PRs.

nodes.label: Rebase Conflict Round
nodes.rationale: Uses repeated sequential composite-action invocations, capped at 500 rounds, to resolve replay conflicts before verifying the completed local rebase.

nodes.label: Dispatch Child PR Transplants
nodes.rationale: Dispatches child PR transplants using captured head and fork-point SHAs, preserving exact snapshot boundaries through the stack cascade.

nodes.label: Refresh Graphify Outputs After Rebase
nodes.rationale: Refreshes Graphify outputs from the completed replay and falls back to AST/text-only updating when semantic extraction is unavailable or fails.

nodes.label: Resolve PR Conflicts Workflow
nodes.rationale: The workflow is the central PR-management control plane for routing, conflict detection and resolution, rebase delegation, repository maintenance, and promotion handoffs.

nodes.label: Detect Merge-Conflicting PRs
nodes.rationale: Re-derives live PR and branch state, classifies ownership and eligibility, snapshots exact refs, and reports or hands off eligible work.

nodes.label: Hand Off Selected PR Batch
nodes.rationale: Dispatches bounded, selected PR batches to the protected control-plane revision after coalescing obsolete queued workers and accounting for durable fleet capacity.

nodes.label: Maintain All Branch
nodes.rationale: Routes the all-branch build and repair operation through the central manager.

nodes.label: Manage Rebases
nodes.rationale: Delegates eligible rebase and stack-cascade management to the dedicated reusable workflow.

nodes.label: Validate Trusted Promotion Handoff
nodes.rationale: Validates the immutable promotion plan, source PR, live branch refs, reservation commit, and provenance before starting a secret-bearing worker.

nodes.label: Feature Stack Merge Job
nodes.rationale: Builds an exact ordered stack of two-parent merge commits and leaves publication to a later trusted step.

nodes.label: Resolve Promotion Job
nodes.rationale: Reconstructs and verifies immutable promotion snapshots before publishing a reviewable PR, with recovery handling for partial completion.

nodes.label: Import Developer ID and Notarization Credentials

nodes.label: Cascade to stacked PRs step
nodes.rationale: Dispatch child PRs in bounded batches and cap cascade depth to avoid unbounded work.

nodes.label: Rebuild Graphify structure and semantic extraction step
nodes.norm_label: rebuild graphify structure and semantic extraction step
nodes.rationale: Graph refresh is best effort and must not prevent publishing a verified resolution; preserve the valid structural refresh if semantic extraction fails.

nodes.label: Push merge commit step
nodes.rationale: Revalidate the immutable snapshot and ownership immediately before publication, and prove the remote ref outcome before deciding whether to retry.

nodes.label: API capability manifests
nodes.rationale: Every externally reachable API endpoint is represented in an origin-scoped manifest generated from the canonical registry and active runtime route map.

nodes.label: api.auth-characters capability
nodes.rationale: The selected origin must negotiate a compatible version before Character operations; capability or access failure does not grant a fallback identity.

nodes.label: Thingtime Character coordination
nodes.rationale: Each active chat or agent claims a distinct Character and reports task status in the private Thingtime Agents subspace when authorized access and capabilities are available.

nodes.label: Thingtime Agents subspace
nodes.rationale: The subspace is private; task-related coordination posts and membership administration are authorized within its stated scope.

nodes.label: Control-plane README
nodes.rationale: The branch is a thin CI control plane, so operational documentation and rollout boundaries are preserved here.

nodes.label: Review Handoff Job
nodes.rationale: Serializes review dispatches and coalesces only reconstructable signals so human comment events are not dropped.

nodes.label: things_v2 collection
nodes.rationale: Physical collections are versioned; logical things maps to things_v2 through the schema version and collection-name modules.

nodes.label: promotion-pr: open or refresh promotion PR
nodes.norm_label: promotion-pr: open or refresh promotion pr

nodes.label: Web CI workflow
nodes.rationale: A scope job assigns stable required-context names to full web checks or lightweight companions, avoiding permanently pending checks for non-web changes.

nodes.label: Classify Web CI scope job
nodes.rationale: Inspect the checked-out tree and pull-request file list so branch names and path filters do not misclassify applicability; truncated API results fail safe to full CI.

nodes.label: Browser automation preference
nodes.rationale: Use the assigned Chrome profile for real-account work and task-owned isolated browsers for tests; preserve account separation and use supported recovery paths.

nodes.label: Thingtime password manager
nodes.rationale: Credentials for agent task actions must be obtained through the device's supported password-manager interface and kept out of logs, chat, and artifacts.

nodes.label: Everything-is-a-thing model
nodes.rationale: Entities are stored as Things by kind; appended data uses separate atomic child Things linked through parentId.

nodes.label: CodeQL analysis workflow
nodes.rationale: Coordinates analysis ownership and upload timing to avoid duplicate or incomplete aggregate CodeQL checks while failing open when uncertain.

nodes.label: Rebase PR stacks workflow
nodes.rationale: Restricts automatic rewrites to validated same-repository stacks, isolates model edits in scratch, verifies exact snapshots, and delays remote ref changes until replay and Graphify refresh complete.

nodes.label: Comment on PR needs attention step
nodes.community_name: Comment on PR needs attention step
nodes.norm_label: comment on pr needs attention step
nodes.rationale: Report residual conflicts only after rechecking current ownership and exact refs; preserve user-controlled pause labels.

nodes.label: Feature Stack Merge Gate Job
nodes.rationale: Waits for the exact verified target PR to merge while preserving branch protection as the final gate.

nodes.label: Feature Stack Plan Job
nodes.rationale: Revalidates immutable source and target snapshots, and recovers already-merged stacks without repeating model work.

nodes.label: Feature Stack Receipt Reconciliation Job
nodes.rationale: Publishes a terminal success receipt for a stack already merged on its exact targets.

nodes.label: Model Config Job
nodes.rationale: Loads resolver model configuration only for trusted internal worker modes.

nodes.label: Semantic CAS cache variants
nodes.rationale: Semantic responses are stored additively by input key and content hash so divergent valid responses coexist.

nodes.label: Immutable Graphify snapshots
nodes.rationale: Portable snapshots are immutable and content-addressed; mutable aliases, reports, caches, and temporary state remain local.

nodes.label: Legacy user collections
nodes.rationale: Existing legacy records may be updated, but new records must not be added to these collections.

nodes.label: Rebase conflict round action
nodes.rationale: Runs each conflict resolution in bounded repo-less scratch, verifies submitted bytes against the immutable real-rebase state, then continues the rebase deterministically.
